newsitem.title: UK: LME copper falls further in after-hours trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper falls further in after-hours trading.

text.p: LME copper fell further in late inter-office trading on Wednesday evening as other base metals also retained their weaker trend as light long liquidation emerged after recent good gains, traders said.
At 1900 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,360/$2,364 per tonne, compared to a $2,375 kerb close, the day's lows.
Copper finished the kerb with a $20 loss on the day. The metal had started strong above $2,400, thanks in part to news that Asarco's copper output in southern Peru had been curtailed due to flooding.
The other metals were also lower with aluminium indicated at $2,666/$1,669 versus a $1,673 close on the kerb and zinc at $1,236/$1,240 compared to $1,240.
